# A test names the component under test with its second parameter, and the
# driver passes that name as rootComponent so the platform builds its Model
# from it. That only worked while nothing else in the program rendered.
#
# With any root present -- a top-level composition, or a `component main` --
# the root instantiates the component under test, so passInlinePure flattens it
# and renames its state per instance. The Model then carries `n__inst0` while
# the agent, written against the declaration, asks for `n`:
#
#     ./testagent_main.go:9:10: c.n undefined (type Model has no field
#                               or method n)
#
# The cause was ordering: the package was lowered once, before the group -- and
# therefore the root -- was known. Each group now lowers its own clone with its
# own root, the way each build target already does.
#
# The three files differ only in what surrounds the component under test, which
# is the whole regression.

sngl test --platform none alone.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform none composed.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform none rooted.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform html alone.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform html composed.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform html rooted.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform bubbletea alone.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform bubbletea composed.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform bubbletea rooted.sngl
stdout 'ok'

# Two components under test in one file: each group is its own root, so
# neither is inlined into the other or into the composition above them.
#
# Their parameters are deliberately named something other than `c`. The agent
# used to declare a fixed `c := newTestComponent()`, so a test that called its
# handle anything else built against a binding that was never made:
#
#     ./testagent_main.go:9:8: undefined: g
sngl test --platform none two.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform html two.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform bubbletea two.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- alone.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component counter node {
    var n = 3
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

func testInitial(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.n == 3)
}

window {
}
-- composed.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component counter node {
    var n = 3
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

func testInitial(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.n == 3)
}

window {
    counter()
}
-- rooted.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    counter()
}

component counter node {
    var n = 3
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

func testInitial(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.n == 3)
}

window {
    main
}
-- two.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component counter node {
    var n = 3
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
    }
}

component greeter node {
    var who = "world"
    vbox {
        text(value="hi {who}")
    }
}

func testCounter(t Test, cnt counter) {
    t.assert(cnt.n == 3)
}

func testGreeter(t Test, g greeter) {
    t.assert(g.who == "world")
}

window {
    vbox {
        counter()
        greeter()
    }
}
